integrity: The theorem is proved symbolically from the stated hypotheses. The finite-field program is an independent finite sanity check, not evidence for the general quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: The criterion is sufficient rather than necessary.
The result does not classify all 2-local half-derivations.
Residual originality risk remains from older or weakly indexed literature.
title: A center–abelianization criterion for nonlinear 2-local half-derivations
